name: Beeline Workspace
description:
Beeline is a workforce capability platform built for large, multi-site, distributed-frontline operators — retail, franchise, healthcare, and industrial teams training their own frontline workers. This connector gives Claude direct access to your Beeline workspace so you can manage and analyze your training operation without leaving the conversation.

Build and edit courses (beelines): create sections, cells, assessments, and surveys, or generate new content from a plain-language instruction. Manage your org structure: create, move, rename, or merge learner groups, and move people between them. Design job roles with competencies and KPIs. Get insights on demand: completion and progression rates, at-risk learners and sites, practical assessment pass rates, learner feedback and sentiment, and competency gap analysis — broken down by any group tag (region, store format, area manager).

Requires an existing Beeline workspace and admin-level access.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Beeline Workspace to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Beeline Workspace to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.beeline.life/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Beeline Workspace MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Beeline Workspace lists 78 MCP tools, including add_beeline_to_library, add_cell, add_digital_resource_cell, add_question, add_section, add_survey_field, attach_source, bulk_create_groups, bulk_edit_groups, compare_groups, confirm_proposal, and create_beeline.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Beeline Workspace?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Beeline Workspace in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does Beeline Workspace MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Beeline Workspace requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Beeline Workspace is developed by Beeline. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
